title: Humene language — Grokipedia
text: Humene (also Humeme; ISO 639-3: huf) is a Trans–New Guinea language of the Kwalean family, spoken by approximately 940 people (2000 census) primarily in the Rigo Sub-District of Central Province, Papua New Guinea.
